chunks: When it comes down on their plains, it will be an evil dawn for those who had been warned.
ai.seo_question: What does the 'evil dawn' refer to in Surah As-Saff?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the suddenness of divine retribution for those who arrogantly awaited the punishment, emphasizing that the 'evil dawn' signifies not just a time of day but the awakening to the reality of their failure. The phrase 'descended upon their courtyard' (sahat) implies a public and inescapable humiliation, contrasting with the private warnings they ignored. This serves as a poignant reminder of the consequences of delaying repentance despite clear signs.
